items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Through Skinny Ennis this man who had the band in California, I met Claude Thornhill and I was sent to him to write for the orchestra.

ctx.x: Which means you don't have those (the articles?) of early manuscripts around any more?
I lost all those. I left those at, I left those at Skinny [Ennis's] basement you know. (unintelligible) There was nowhere else to store them, so I scored them there.
I read somewhere that your band was active at Modesto College in California, that it started there in Modesto.
